Title: Ice Roads
Content: `text(Every winter)`, Mason enjoys visiting his cousin Clara in Bayfield, Wisconsin. He loves when they drive across frozen Lake Superior on an ice road to reach Madeline Island.
This ice road is special to Mason because there is no ice road near his home in Torr Head, which is along the Irish Sea in Northern Ireland.
But when Mason visited Bayfield last winter, there was less ice and no ice road. He wonders if there will ever be an ice road again.
